body:

[cliro] 😁 I mean: Can i get cashback again if i have already received cashback on this deal before ?
[Zeee] Last deal was $120 for gas switched. But tracked only 70. Top cashback customer service not good.
[greensky310] I agree with their CS being disappointing. I had queried about an untracked cash back and had to chase them down so that it would track. Even then, when I asked a simple questions (why was there a delay in the processing after my purchased was tracked), I was threatened by being told that every time I ask any question, my enquiry will be pulled out and the waiting will just get longer. I will never be using their service again.
[greensky310] I have already done that, but I don't have high hopes with them at this point. Just a bit disgusted with TCB's attitude towards customers.
[Zeee] @greensky310: ACCC only acts when complaints pour in hundreds and thousands.
[udika] My cashback for Everyday Rewards Market from 19/6 deal did not track and after the missing cashback claim was reviewed, only $16 out of $98 (30% of purchase) is given. Are there any store reps that can assist me with this?
[A female dog] Still waiting for my last one to be tracked…
[anna tucker] plans are expensive listed here than energy comparison plans
[ShanghaiRocks] My last one says “pending” and “estimated payable” 22 weeks. 😳
[JustWantToSave] They pay out a bit early usually. Mine and many others last one paid out about 16 days early.
But yeah, still a long wait. Though I'm getting electricity and internet anyway, so cash back on it is worth the wait. Especially since you can get multiple started before one pays out.
[wolfazrael123] I haven't got my gift card which should be received half year go.
[Save Medicare] Do you guys always do gas and electricity together? Gas it always takes ages to connect and get the first bill…
I feel like I could squeeze in an extra electricity cashback if I did electricity -> electricity + gas -> electricity -> electricity + gas cycle
